name: 49969-longprompt-8b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B (target) + deepseek-ai/dspark_qwen3_8b_block7 (DSpark drafter) -- the drafter's own config declares num_target_layers 36 and target_layer_ids [1, 9, 17, 25, 33], and this is the pair vLLM's model registry lists for a Qwen3 DSpark drafter.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process engine (guidellm `vllm_python`), no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: Qwen3ForCausalLM target, 36 layers, 32 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, bf16, 144 KiB KV per token, 16.4 GB of weights; drafter is a 5-layer Qwen3DSparkModel, block_size 7, 4.7 GB. 21.1 GB on one card.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, bounded at 200 requests; the 10% warmup resolves to a request count and takes 21, so 179 are measured.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, exactly 8192 prompt and 1024 output tokens (min = max on both), temperature 1.0, seed 42, prefix caching off and prompts drawn independently so every request is a real 8192-token prefill. The `vllm_python` backend renders each row as a user message and applies the chat template, so the engine's own prompt-token count reads a handful above 8192, and it sets ignore_eos, so every request emits exactly 1024 tokens.
purpose: A long-document analysis assistant with draft-model acceleration, serving one user at a time, eight-thousand-token prompts, single GPU.
launch:
# The engine is the source checkout named by `configs/env.yaml: venv`, a commit and not a release.
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B

# The drafter is a 4.7 GB download and is not in the local HF cache; the target is.
speculative-config: {"model": "deepseek-ai/dspark_qwen3_8b_block7", "method": "dspark", "num_speculative_tokens": 7, "draft_sample_method": "probabilistic", "attention_backend": "FLASH_ATTN"}

tensor-parallel-size: 1

# Pinned, not left to a default: guidellm's in-process `vllm_python` backend builds the engine
# under a usage context the per-device default table does not cover, so unpinned it falls to this
# commit's class defaults of 2048 batched tokens and 128 sequences -- a materially different setup.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 32

enable-prefix-caching: false
trust-remote-code: true
max-model-len: 16384

# If you ever attach a profiler: CUPTI trace buffers push model load into OOM at this value, and
# 0.70 clears it. Nothing here is profiled by default.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.80

enable-chunked-prefill: true
